text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While eating in the cafeteria, I overhear<n>Mejiro
Bright and Fine Motion having a<n>discussion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A message from a prince?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This morning I received an email<n>from
someone claiming to be the prince<n>of a certain
country.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, he has a surplus of wealth<n>and is
searching for someone who will<n>use that money
effectively.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so he's a philanthropist? But I<n>wonder if a
member of royalty would<n>send an email like that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So, did you reply?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I refused his offer. There's no way I<n>can
accept money from a complete<n>stranger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But then I received another message<n>saying the
prince was involved in an<n>accident...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My, what are the chances!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, he was seriously injured and<n>is
requesting assistance with his medical<n>costs.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on. Wasn't this the same fellow<n>who had so
much money he wanted to<n>give it away?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: He said all his money burned up in the<n>accident.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so all his funds were in cash? And<n>this must
have been a mighty fire to<n>have destroyed all that
capital. It's<n>strange that I haven't seen any news<n>
about it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to remain silent any longer, I<n>intrude upon
their conversation.
choice_data_list: It's all a bunch of lies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: What? Is that right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I thought it all sounded a smidge<n>too
convenient! His claim of being a<n>prince, then
getting hurt in an<n>accident—so it was all a big
scam, then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it seems so obvious now! Well, that's<n>an
enormous relief.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It means there was no accident, and that<n>no one
was hurt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite almost being deceived by this<n>"prince,"
Mejiro Bright still feels a great<n>sense of relief.
choice_data_list: You really are a kind person.

You need to learn a little more about how the
world works.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The news about the accident felt so<n>sudden that I
was simply overcome with<n>worry. I didn't think to
question it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's a fine shame there are people out<n>there trying
to take advantage of that<n>sort of good will. Let's
be sure to stay<n>vigilant, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: How the world works... I see.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, you should be able to<n>tell
whether an email is a scam or not.
choice_data_list:
It's best to ignore emails from people you don't
know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense! And it sounds much<n>better than
checking each and every<n>message one by one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your advice. I'll definitely<n>be more
careful from now on!
choice_data_list:
You should also change your email address if
possible.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! It'd be quite the bother if that<n>false
prince contacted you again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You're absolutely right! ...So how would<n>one do
that?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Uhh, I'm sorry, I don't know either! My<n>security
team handles that sort of thing<n>for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I end up helping Mejiro Bright<n>change her
email address.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! Thank you very much<n>for your
advice.
